sections.heading: About this policy
sections.text: This proposed policy is for CloudDesk, a fictional 75-person B2B SaaS company. It sets requirements for employee accounts and administrative access.

sections.heading: Employee accounts
sections.text: All employees must use unique user accounts.

sections.heading: Administrative access
sections.text: Multi-factor authentication is required for administrative access.

sections.heading: Document status
sections.text: SYNTHETIC / DEMO. This is a model-authored proposed policy for review. It does not show that these controls are in use or that CloudDesk is certified or compliant. Review_status: requires_user_review. Approval_status: not_recorded.

sections.heading: Access reviews
sections.text: CloudDesk reviews user access permissions every quarter.

sections.heading: Terminated employees
sections.text: Terminated employee access is revoked within 24 hours.

sections.heading: How to read these requirements
sections.text: These statements describe proposed requirements. They are not records of completed access reviews or access removal. This policy does not set additional roles, procedures or approval arrangements.
